role_and_message.evidence: The M figure still motivates token-level sensor fusion by three local modality advantages.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: All nine RGB/events/depth observations and their original red ROIs remain in three corresponding scene rows.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: RGB/Events/Depth names and road marking/tunnel exit/cyclist statements exactly retain the source examples.

connections_and_direction.evidence: Each row groups three sensors viewing the same source scene and highlights the original best-local-evidence modality; no cross-scene correspondence or new causal edge is introduced.

visual_encodings.evidence: Blue RGB, orange event and magenta depth emphasis matches source. Every original red ROI and event/depth color value is retained.

examples_and_data.evidence: All nine complete source sensor regions independently match deterministic proportional resizes, preserving exposure, event patterns, depth fields and ROIs.

unsupported_additions.evidence: New title and token-level conclusion restate source Fig1 caption and Introduction; no new robustness metric or universal per-modality ranking is added.

complete_visible_content.evidence: All nine images, ROI borders, modality labels and local explanations remain visible; original sensor resolution is retained through documented resampling.

remaining_limitations: Original illustrative scope remains. Qualitative optics is not calibrated geometry; empirical panels retain source resolution via documented resampling. Visual polish is judged separately.
